users: learners and instructors studying liquid-cooled rack thermal physics
supported_tasks: teach energy balance and second-law constraints
not_intended_for: a calibrated rack, cold-plate, CDU, pump, or facility model; hardware prediction; or operational design decisions

outputs: illustrative temperatures, heat paths, transient response, and explanation prompts

limitations: Inputs are synthetic teaching assumptions, not inventory, telemetry, vendor, or hardware data.
The one-node single-phase lesson has limited property and hardware applicability.
